text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it looks like you're working hard 
for the Umamusume today as well.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Just as you support <chrname>-chan, I'll support 
the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
I will gently envelop you all in vast 
knowledge, so don't worry about a thing.
